prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE realistic production-quality high-fidelity macOS ReadingBook UI design concept, 1440×1024 landscape viewport. One entire app screen, no device/browser bezel, poster, numbered label, caption, or collage. Current date is2026-10-15; no calendar UI or fictional recent dates needed.
Input image1 is the user-approved FLOATING LAYOUT reference, not a mandatory color/material palette. The user specifically requests alternatives to its forest green look. Retain its readable Chinese interface, compact book mark identity, all-floating tools and reading-first arrangement. Treat these three new images as comparable proposals, not existing app screenshots.
HARD PRODUCT CONSTRAINTS:
The original PDF is the default. Main reading content is a stable white/ivory PDF page with dark ink and correct-looking professionally typeset mathematical systems/matrices, not a see-through sheet. The mock book content is only illustrative and must never masquerade as verified OCR. Use the same short exercise on all designs: title '高斯–若当消元法', exercise '判断下列线性方程组是否有解，并求出全部解。', then a3-line aligned system, an augmented matrix and a compact sequence of row operations with generous margins. Avoid gratuitously huge chapter heading. Main mathematics readable and not behind panels.
NO permanent top toolbar band, NO fixed left sidebar/rail, NO full-height right inspector column. No horizontal titlebar divider. PDF/reading canvas occupies virtually the whole viewport. Native macOS traffic lights at upper-left without a solid titlebar.
Exactly these floating functional groups:
- compact book-title glass island at upper-left just after traffic lights, small recognizable book glyph, '线性代数 · 习题解析', chevron;
- two separate upper-right floating islands, 'DeepSeek' selector with a status indicator, and one clearly labeled primary action '继续精读'. No anonymous play triangle, no repeated AI service control;
- a collapsed navigation entry at the middle of left edge: ONE modest dot/pebble with a clear glass halo and generous invisible44px hit area. No expanded rail, no added permanent menu;
- ONE movable companion window roughly320px wide,400–450px tall floating toward upper-middle RIGHT, at least24px away from window edges, with paper visible around AND below it. Rounded but not excessively round. Subtle drag handle, title '伴读', collapse and close controls. Inside one concise selected-quote line, source chip '第1页 · 第2段', then '行变换不改变方程组的解集。先消去第一列，再寻找主元。', then two supporting actions '回到原句' and '问这里'. Avoid cards inside cards, repeated full equations, reading dashboards, meters, or tall panel just to fill space. Interior must be readable and sufficiently opaque. Position panel over spare page margin rather than mathematics;
- ONE bottom-center floating reading island: previous, '1 / 3', next, separator, '适合宽度' menu, search icon, overflow.44px-ish targets,8–12px gaps. No second toolbar/page-number row. Main source equation unobscured by this control.
Typography: native clear CJK controls13–15px, book mathematical prose about20–22px. At most two fonts. Restrained modern Apple feel, purposeful spacing, distinct hierarchy. Functional glass floating above stable content, believable optical blur, careful border highlight, not fake neon. Keep controls generous but avoid thick permanent chrome or wasted empty bands.
This visual system must be extensible later to a geographic map with ONE floating dual-handle time range, an infinite mindmap with right floating node inspector, Markdown notes, plugin management and model settings. Do not draw those pages or advertise them in this focused reader frame. Tokens, panel shape and control hierarchy must feel suitable for these productive surfaces as well.
Do not invent extra navigation tabs, analytics, badges, metrics, cards, explanatory legend or decorative illustrations.
STYLE DIRECTION — “霜银 · 钴蓝” / Frost Silver and Cobalt:
A light, precise, quiet contemporary macOS instrument. Near-white cool canvas #F5F7FA, crystal-silver tool surfaces #F9FBFF at85–93% opacity, charcoal text #26313C, cobalt primary #3569D5 and a very pale blue selection tint. Replace forest green entirely; the book glyph may be monochrome or cobalt, preserve its opened-book identity. Status indicator may use conventional green but never tint the whole interface green.
Control construction: understated softly squared glass rectangles,12–14px corners rather than ubiquitous fully round pills; companion corners18px, slim luminous1px rim, extremely fine silver separators. Main action is a compact saturated cobalt lozenge with white text; secondary action translucent silver. Floating tools feel precise and light, tiny optical blue undertone along lower rims, soft short shadows not hazy glowing blobs. Companion text grouped on one clean plane, no boxed quote card; a small blue vertical source marker. Original PDF paper neutral white. Generous controls and surgical alignment, quiet modern professional Apple desktop, no decorative gradients, charts or fashion-magazine headings. Show clearly different material, corner and control styling from the green reference while preserving the user's floating layout.

STYLE DIRECTION — “暖纸 · 赤陶” / Warm Paper and Terracotta:
Recompose and redraw this UI as a distinct warm editorial reading instrument, NOT a pixel-for-pixel recolor. Use reference1 only for functional floating layout requirements. The complete visual system is tactile, cultured, quiet and contemporary rather than clinical: ivory #F4EFE6 around white PDF paper, espresso ink #302A25, terracotta #A34E35 primary, pale clay #EEE0D3 selection and warm gray-bronze optical borders. There must be NO forest green or cobalt in brand/selected/primary surfaces. Status is a small neutral glyph-plus-text rather than prominent green dot.
Change component geometry and hierarchy recognizably: title and model floating controls are warm satin-glass soft rectangles with10–12px corners, slightly less tall and round than reference1; a fine champagne rim catches the light. Typography feels warm and bookish while controls remain clean native sans-serif; only book prose uses a refined CJK serif. Treat the companion like one movable compact cream reading slip, with16px corners, a narrow terracotta accent rule and NO large boxed inner card. Put '第1页 · 第2段' as a small understated line immediately under the companion title. Selected excerpt is two concise lines, followed by a thin warm rule, then the explanation. Keep the companion slightly lower than the top islands and only400px tall, not a heavy floating dashboard.
The primary 继续精读 action is deep burnt-clay glass with restrained white icon/text; supporting 问这里 is a smaller clay-tinted action, 回到原句 a quiet unboxed icon/text target with generous hit area. Reading control island has softly rectangular profile, delicate vertical ticks between groups, gentle cream translucency, low warm shadow and44px comfortable targets rather than bubble-like circular buttons. The collapsed left navigation is one bronze pebble in an ivory-glass halo.
Lighting is luminous natural warm daylight, slight warm refraction only at tool edges, almost no blue. Original PDF stays clean white with dark mathematical ink, no artificial parchment texture or sepia recoloring of the source. Do not add illustrations, leather, fake paper grain, vintage ornaments, display branding, a thick background band or a permanent column. Full app canvas with airy careful spacing and substantial readable paper.

STYLE DIRECTION — “暮色 · 鸢尾” / Graphite and Iris:
Create a clearly distinct evening-oriented macOS visual system: graphite glass #20242D, smoky obsidian translucent tools #292D39, soft off-white UI text #EEEFF6, iris-violet focus/primary #9282E8, fine neutral graphite shadows and luminous hairline rim. No forest green, blue primary or terracotta brand accents. This must look like a sophisticated quiet productive app, NOT a gaming HUD, neon sci-fi or purple gradient wallpaper.
CRITICAL: ORIGINAL PDF STAYS WHITE WITH BLACK MATHEMATICAL INK. Do NOT invert, recolor or fade the source PDF to create fake dark mode. Dark theme applies to app chrome, floating windows, controls and the neutral narrow surrounding reading canvas only. The source page is large and flat, reaching within about12–24px of window edges, so reading space remains excellent. No thick dark border, no contained rounded app-card mockup. No dark fixed sidebar or titleband.
Change the material and silhouette: title and model selectors are low-profile smoked dark glass capsules with fine crisp white rim highlights and calm matte centers; button height about44–48px. The primary action is iris-tinted smoked glass with light typography, not glowing purple neon. Companion window is a compact dark smoky translucent pane,20px corners, soft broad natural shadow against white PDF, visibly floating at upper-middle right. Title/handle/close are clear light glyphs, selected quote has one small violet source rule, body explanation is soft-white sans-serif on a stable sufficiently opaque graphite interior with no inner card. Source location is a quiet lavender-gray line of text, not a bright badge. Bottom panel actions use a restrained outlined secondary and iris-tinted primary with clearly separated44px targets.
Bottom reading island is a single dark smoky glass capsule, slightly deeper optical rim than the light styles, simple monochrome controls and violet focus accent, not glossy round bubbles for every icon. Left collapsed navigation is one small pale iris dot inside a smoked glass halo. Preserve whitespace between the independent floating top islands; no bar behind them.
Atmosphere: serene evening, confident generous controls, restrained contrast, subtle dark optical glass, original clean white paper. Make it immediately distinguishable from the light reference, not merely an accent-color replacement. Precise native CJK controls, luminous but very readable, no decorative diagrams or extra features.
